```{r}
library(sangchem)
library(dplyr)

# identify samples in which we have at least one callow  and two mature F. sanguinea 
data("development_data")
development_data_clean <- filter(development_data, caste=="worker",!is.na(head_width), !remarks %in% c("aggression actor", "aggression target", "queenless colony"), species=="F. sanguinea") %>%
  dplyr::select(chromatogram_ID, species, colony, sang_prop, head_width, mass, census_date, callow, caste) 

get_age_related_distance <- function(callow_chr_ID, mature_chr_IDs){
  if(length(mature_chr_IDs)<2) stop("Less than two chromatograms for mature F. sanguinea ants.")
  res <- list()
  mature_combinations <- list()
  for(i in 1:(length(mature_chr_IDs)-1)){
    for(j in (i+1):length(mature_chr_IDs))
    mature_combinations[[(mature_combinations)+1]] <- c(i,j)
  }
  res$mature_distance <- mean(unlist(lapply(mature_combinations, function(vec) pair_distance(vec[1], vec[2]))))
  res$callow_mature_distance <- mean(unlist(lapply(mature_chr_IDs, pair_distance, callow_chr_ID)))
  res
}

callow_chr_IDs <- filter(development_data_clean, callow==1) %>% pull(chromatogram_ID)
callow_nestmates <- lapply(callow_chr_IDs, find_sample_nestmate, heterospecific=FALSE)
```
